_comment: Permissions for the paper-loop CONTAINER (jobRoleArn): durable-state S3 read/write under EACH account's own state prefix, and CloudWatch put-metric-data for the dead-man's-switch. T-288: the fleet accounts write paper_state_offense_sso/* and paper_state_btc_sleeve/* — `paper_state/*` does NOT match those, so their pushes were silently AccessDenied (CloudState fails open). T-325 (2026-08-05): the SAME class recurred — the daily news-panel push (news_panel/YYYY/MM/) and the alt-data hoard push (altdata/) go to DIFFERENT prefixes than paper_state/, so push_news_month/push_altdata were silently AccessDenied every run and the panel never accrued in-cloud (the empty-tape root cause; silent-wrongness near-miss #5). Both prefixes granted now, and the push methods now CHECK the return code. Prefixes are enumerated EXPLICITLY (not a wildcard) so a new prefix must be granted deliberately. Deliberately NOT granted broker creds (those come via the execution role's Secrets Manager binding) and NOT granted any live-trading AWS surface. __RESULTS_BUCKET__ substituted at deploy.
